causal_chain: A residual anti-collapse pairwise term can prevent all users and items from concentrating on the same few prototypes, keeping the multi-intent mechanism active.
A small bank of shared latent prototypes lets each user and item be represented as adaptive mixtures rather than single points, preserving separable collaborative facets.

If prototype routing is the operative mechanism, full-sort ranking should improve especially for users with diverse histories and for items supported by one coherent facet rather than global popularity.

User-specific routing based on agreement and disagreement between user-history prototype weights and candidate-item prototype weights can elevate items matching a minority but coherent intent instead of only the dominant average taste.
Users in ML-1M often express multiple stable but partially conflicting taste facets that collapse into one embedding under standard collaborative filters.
blind_projection.competing_explanation: Any gain could come only from increased parameter count or extra nonlinear scoring capacity rather than true multi-intent prototype routing; a similarly sized dense scorer without adaptive prototype mixtures might match the effect.
discriminative_predictions: A mechanism-off variant that averages prototype weights into a single effective embedding should lose most of the gain if adaptive mixture routing is essential.
Compared with matched BPR_MF, the candidate should show larger NDCG@10 gains for users whose training histories have high internal item-embedding dispersion.
Prototype usage entropy should remain meaningfully above collapse for both users and items when the anti-collapse term is active, and performance should degrade when that term is removed.

The candidate should retrieve more held-out items whose nearest training-history support comes from a minority subset of the user's interactions rather than the user's globally dominant taste cluster.
expected_evidence: Mechanism-on outperforms its mechanism-off ablation under the same split and training budget.
Per-user slice analysis indicates stronger relative benefit on mixed-taste users than on homogeneous-history users.
Qualification run completes as a candidate-local RecBole GeneralRecommender under pairwise training and full-sort evaluation.
User/item prototype assignment statistics show non-degenerate multi-prototype usage.
blind_projection.falsifier: If a matched single-embedding or single-channel scorer with comparable parameter count matches or exceeds the proposed model, or if collapsing adaptive mixtures to one embedding leaves performance unchanged, then the prototype-routing hypothesis is not supported.
blind_projection.high_change_justification: This proposal changes the core representation from one embedding per user/item to adaptive mixtures over shared prototypes, changes the interaction structure by introducing disagreement-aware routing between prototype mixtures, and adds a distinct anti-collapse training term required to preserve the intended mechanism. These capabilities are absent from the active profile catalog, which is limited to MF and LightGCN descendants plus local objective/sampling/propagation variants.
blind_projection.hypothesis: A candidate-local pairwise recommender that represents each user and item as adaptive mixtures over shared latent prototypes, then scores user-item pairs through disagreement-aware prototype routing with a residual anti-collapse objective, will improve full-sort NDCG@10 on ML-1M over a matched single-embedding collaborative filtering control because it can preserve and selectively activate minority but coherent user intents that static embeddings average away.
implementation_requirements: Cache or precompute training-history summaries per user from train interactions only; do not use chronological or held-out information.
Compute item prototype mixture weights from each item's base embedding.
Compute user prototype mixture weights from the user's base embedding plus an aggregated training-history item summary available from the train split only.
Construct a routed interaction score combining direct user-item affinity, prototype-mixture affinity, and a disagreement gate derived from divergence between user and item prototype weights.
Expose a clean mechanism-off ablation by collapsing prototype routing to a single effective embedding and removing the anti-collapse term.
Implement a new RecBole GeneralRecommender with learnable user base embeddings, item base embeddings, and a shared prototype table.
Provide full-sort predict over all items for evaluation under the frozen protocol.
Train with standard pairwise BPR loss plus an anti-collapse regularizer encouraging distributed prototype utilization and discouraging trivial single-prototype domination.
blind_projection.matched_control_requirement: Use a matched BPR_MF control with comparable embedding dimensionality, optimizer family, negative sampling protocol, and total training epochs, and additionally compare against a mechanism-off version with the same parameter budget but no adaptive prototype routing.
blind_projection.mechanism_change: Replace single-vector user/item representations with shared-prototype adaptive mixtures and score through user-item prototype agreement/disagreement routing plus anti-collapse pairwise regularization.
blind_projection.mechanism_off_definition: Disable adaptive prototype routing by replacing user and item prototype mixtures with a single averaged effective embedding per entity, score only with direct dot-product affinity, and remove the anti-collapse regularizer while keeping the rest of training and evaluation unchanged.
blind_projection.minimal_testable_wedge: A two-channel prototype-mixture recommender: direct user-item dot product plus adaptive prototype-mixture affinity, trained with pairwise BPR and a prototype anti-collapse regularizer, compared against matched BPR_MF and the same model with prototype routing collapsed off.
blind_projection.research_question: Under the frozen ML-1M pairwise full-sort protocol, does adaptive user/item mixture representation over shared collaborative prototypes provide ranking benefit beyond single-embedding collaborative filtering by better modeling multi-intent preference without sequence supervision?
blind_projection.resource_hypothesis: Implementation is feasible within the stated budget because ML-1M is small, the model can use a modest prototype bank with matrix operations only, and qualification should fit comfortably in a single short GPU run or CPU-equivalent wall-clock window.
